name: Failed snippets log
action: Read-only list of the snippets that failed to compile

name: Choose your skin (first-run)
action: initSettings.skin = skin — picks the skin during first-run setup

name: Choose your language (first-run)
action: Selects the UI language during first-run setup

name: Start quick program introduction walkthrough
action: Toggles whether the intro walkthrough runs after first-run setup

name: Close first-run settings
action: closeInitSettings(false) — closes the first-run settings dialog without saving

name: Save first-run settings
action: closeInitSettings(true) — saves the chosen skin/language/walkthrough and closes the dialog

name: Confirm dialog: OK
action: Generic confirm dialog (#confirmDialog): OK — appears for databank clear, capacity reduction, config overwrite…

name: Confirm dialog: No / Cancel
action: Generic confirm dialog (#confirmDialog): callback(false) — the button reads "No" when yesNo is set, otherwise "Cancel"

name: Confirm dialog: close (X)
action: Generic confirm dialog (#confirmDialog): onClose() — dismisses the dialog via the header X, without answering

name: File picker: modal
action: The shared file/folder picker dialog. Lives in the SHELL document (managed by sqUtilsCtrl), not a module frame, whatever Browse button opened it — so its refs carry no preconditions: the opener differs per caller

name: File picker: current location
action: Breadcrumb of the folder currently shown in the picker

name: File picker: path

label.en: Type or paste a full file path

action: Type an absolute path instead of walking the folder tree; Enter (or Open) confirms it

name: File picker: Open
action: onOpenTyped() — accepts the typed path / selected entry and closes the picker

name: File picker: Cancel
action: Dismisses the picker without selecting anything

name: Error dialog
action: The shell-level error dialog (#errorDialog) — the app's generic failure surface for server/validation errors. Lives in the SHELL document whatever module raised the error, so its refs carry no preconditions: the trigger differs per caller (same shape as the shell.file-picker.* block)
conditional: only while a server/validation error is displayed

name: Error dialog: OK
action: Dismisses the shell error dialog; a leftover dialog's backdrop swallows the next test's first click
conditional: only while a server/validation error is displayed

name: Results overlay iframe
action: The results overlay iframe (#iframe_results_overlayed) — rendered while a strategy's results are open; two ng-if variants (RESULTS/RESULTS2) share the testid, only one exists at a time

name: Resolve custom resources: modal
action: The #resolveCustomResourcesPopup modal (ResolveCustomResourcesPopupCtrl) - appears when a loaded template/strategy carries custom blocks / random groups this instance does not have; per-row default action for a missing block/group is 'Create' (add). Lives in the SHELL document (the module frame bubbles via window.parent.callAction), so no preconditions: the opener differs per caller

name: Resolve custom resources: Continue loading
action: onSubmit() - applies each row's chosen action (default 'add') via project/resolveCustomResources and hides the popup; THIS is what writes the blocks/groups into user/settings/customBlocks.xml + blockGroups.xml

name: Resolve custom resources: Close
action: onCancelImport() - hides the popup WITHOUT resolving; nothing is written

name: Resolve project resources: popup
action: The #resolveResourcesPopup modal - appears on boot when the Builder loads a task config whose symbols differ from the local data

name: Resolve project resources: submit (Load config using these settings)
action: onSubmit() - loads the config using the resolved settings and hides the popup

name: Notification toasts (container)
action: The sqNotices toast stack appended to <body> — visible only while at least one notice is open

name: Notification toast (by type)
action: One toast panel of the given type — sqNotices.addNotice(type, text); type is success | error | notice

name: Success toast
action: Green success toast raised by $rootScope.showSuccess(message)

name: Error toast
action: Red error toast raised by $rootScope.showError(message) — NOT the modal #errorDialog (shell.error.*)

name: Notification toast: message text
action: Detail text of the FRONTMOST toast (the .active panel) — the string passed to addNotice(), prefixed by the literal "Details:"

name: Notification toast: close (x)
action: Dismiss the frontmost toast early — toasts also auto-close after 5 s (sqnotice.js:124)

name: Confirm dialog
action: The generic confirm dialog (#confirmDialog) — testid already exists in the HTML, it was simply never catalogued

name: Confirm dialog: title
action: Title of the generic confirm dialog — identifies WHICH confirm is open (e.g. "Deleting view", "Warning")

name: Confirm dialog: message
action: Body text of the generic confirm dialog
